body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements a comprehensive Cloud-Native Multi-Tenant Provisioning Protocol for ObjectStack, enabling the "Register → Instant ObjectOS" architecture with Turso DB-per-Tenant, metadata-driven deployment, and shared compute with isolated data.

**Changes:**
- Added Turso multi-tenant driver protocol with DB-per-Tenant configuration, lifecycle hooks, and group management schemas
- Created tenant provisioning protocol with request/result schemas, status tracking, and plan/region enums
- Implemented metadata-driven deployment bundle protocol with schema diff, migration plans, and validation
- Added app installation protocol for marketplace apps with compatibility checking and install workflows
- Extended tenant, kernel context, and SQL driver schemas to support multi-tenant provisioning
- Defined 6 new service contracts (ITursoPlatformService, IProvisioningService, ISchemaDiffService, IDeployPipelineService, ITenantRouter, IAppLifecycleService)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 23 out of 23 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/spec/src/system/tenant.zod.ts` | Extended TenantSchema with databaseProvider, connectionConfig, provisioningStatus, plan fields; added TenantUsageSchema and QuotaEnforcementResultSchema; expanded TenantQuotaSchema with deployment quotas |
| `packages/spec/src/system/tenant.test.ts` | Added 185 lines of comprehensive tests for new tenant schema extensions |
| `packages/spec/src/system/provisioning.zod.ts` | New file defining tenant provisioning protocol with status/plan/region enums, provisioning steps, and request/result schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/system/provisioning.test.ts` | New file with 173 lines of tests covering all provisioning schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/system/deploy-bundle.zod.ts` | New file defining deployment protocol with deploy status, schema diff, migration plans, validation, and bundle schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/system/deploy-bundle.test.ts` | New file with 201 lines of tests for deployment bundle schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/system/app-install.zod.ts` | New file defining app installation protocol with manifest, compatibility check, and install request/result schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/system/app-install.test.ts` | New file with 167 lines of tests for app installation schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/system/index.ts` | Added exports for provisioning, deploy-bundle, and app-install modules |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/context.zod.ts` | Extended KernelContextSchema with TenantRuntimeContextSchema for tenant-aware runtime context |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/context.test.ts` | Added 72 lines of tests for TenantRuntimeContextSchema |
| `packages/spec/src/data/index.ts` | Added export for turso-multi-tenant driver |
| `packages/spec/src/data/driver/turso-multi-tenant.zod.ts` | New file defining Turso multi-tenant router configuration with resolver strategies, group config, and lifecycle hooks |
| `packages/spec/src/data/driver/turso-multi-tenant.test.ts` | New file with 183 lines of comprehensive tests for Turso driver schemas |
| `packages/spec/src/data/driver-sql.zod.ts` | Added SQLiteDataTypeMappingDefaults and SQLiteAlterTableLimitations constants for SQLite dialect support |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/turso-platform.ts` | New contract defining ITursoPlatformService interface for Turso Platform API operations |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/provisioning-service.ts` | New contract defining IProvisioningService interface for tenant lifecycle management |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/schema-diff-service.ts` | New contract defining ISchemaDiffService interface for schema introspection and migration generation |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/deploy-pipeline-service.ts` | New contract defining IDeployPipelineService interface for metadata-driven deployments |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/tenant-router.ts` | New contract defining ITenantRouter interface for tenant-aware request routing |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/app-lifecycle-service.ts` | New contract defining IAppLifecycleService interface for app installation/upgrade/uninstall |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/index.ts` | Added exports for all new provisioning and deployment contracts |
| `docs/NEXT_STEP.md` | Updated checklist to mark deployment protocol and service contracts as complete |

There's a redundancy in TenantQuotaSchema: both `maxStorage` (line 70) and `maxStorageBytes` (line 95) represent storage limits in bytes. Consider removing the deprecated `maxStorage` field or clarifying their difference in documentation if they serve different purposes.

The new SQLite-specific constants `SQLiteDataTypeMappingDefaults` and `SQLiteAlterTableLimitations` lack test coverage. Add tests to verify that SQLiteDataTypeMappingDefaults conforms to the DataTypeMapping type and that SQLiteAlterTableLimitations has the expected structure and values.

The tenant plan enum is defined inline here instead of reusing `TenantPlanSchema` from `provisioning.zod.ts`. For consistency and DRY principles, consider importing and using `TenantPlanSchema` instead of duplicating the enum definition. The same applies to `provisioningStatus` which duplicates `TenantProvisioningStatusEnum`.

The tenant plan enum is defined inline here instead of reusing `TenantPlanSchema` from `provisioning.zod.ts`. For consistency and DRY principles, import `TenantPlanSchema` and use it here: `tenantPlan: TenantPlanSchema.describe('Tenant subscription plan')`.

The `tenantRegion` field is defined as a plain string (`z.string().min(1)`) instead of using the `TenantRegionSchema` enum from `provisioning.zod.ts`. For type safety and validation consistency, consider using `TenantRegionSchema` to ensure only valid regions are accepted.
